A Kind of Shield

Click to listen.

Listen to a conversation between two students. The boy is discussing his opinion about how living in groups helps animals survive. Listen carefully. You will hear the conversation only once. After listening, you will answer four questions about the conversation and the evidence the boy gives to support his opinion. As you listen, you may take notes.

Listen to the Conversation

QUESTION 1: Why does the boy mention the videos his cousin sends from Rome?

QUESTION 2: How did the boy learn why the starlings gather in such huge groups?

QUESTION 3: What does the boy say about how the huge group protects the starlings from a falcon?

QUESTION 4: What does the boy conclude about why starlings keep living in big groups?

Answer all 4 questions to submit.

SMART SUPPORT:

Go back to the conversation. Identify why the boy brings up the murmurations over Rome. Identify where he learned why the birds gather. Identify what he says about the falcon. Identify his main point about living in groups.
